requirement.description: Multiple test failures due to AttributeError: 'tuple' object has no attribute 'items' in DSL constructs like If, Elif, Else, Switch, Case, etc. This suggests that code is expecting dictionary-like objects but receiving tuples.
requirement.contract: The DSL constructs (If, Elif, Else, Switch, Case) should properly handle their internal state management and return proper objects that support the expected interface methods like .items().

requirement.description: Several test failures due to mismatched error messages in operator validation and pattern matching. The error messages don't match the expected format in test assertions.
requirement.contract: Error messages for invalid patterns and operators must match the exact format expected by the test cases, including spacing, punctuation, and phrasing.

requirement.description: Missing imports and undefined names causing NameError: name 'MemoryData' is not defined in memory-related tests.
requirement.contract: All necessary imports should be available and properly resolved for memory-related functionality.

requirement.description: AttributeError: 'tuple' object has no attribute 'items' and other similar failures in IR processing, particularly with switch values and assignments.
requirement.contract: IR processing code should correctly handle tuple-based representations and not expect dictionary-like interfaces.

requirement.description: AttributeError: 'tuple' object has no attribute 'items' in coding library tests, indicating improper handling of return values.
requirement.contract: Coding library functions should return proper objects with expected interfaces rather than raw tuples.
